title: Greater or Less Song (Tiny Sparks original)

chorus.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C
chorus.lyrics: Which is big-ger, which is more? / Count them up, then you'll be sure! / Which is small-er, which is less? / Count and make your best guess!

v1.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v1.lyrics: Three red ap-ples, five green pears, / count them up, the fruit's all there. / Five is more and three is less, / five is great-er, yes, yes, yes!

v2.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v2.lyrics: Two lit-tle duck-lings, four lit-tle frogs, / hop-ping and swim-ming by the logs. / Two is less and four is more, / four is great-er, that's the score!

v3.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v3.lyrics: Gator's mouth is o-pen wide, / hun-gry for the big-ger side! / Snap, snap, snap, he eats the most, / he likes the big-ger num-ber most!

v4.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v4.lyrics: Six lit-tle stars and six lit-tle moons, / count them all, they're like bal-loons. / Not more, not less, they're just the same, / e-qual is the num-ber name!

v5.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v5.lyrics: One lit-tle ant and ten lit-tle bees, / which is more? Count, if you please! / One is less and ten is more, / ten is great-er, hear it roar!

q1.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q1.lyrics: Which is more, two or sev-en? / Sev-en!

q2.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q2.lyrics: Which is less, nine or four? / Four!

q3.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q3.lyrics: Which is more, eight or three? / Eight!

q4.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q4.lyrics: Five and five, more or less? / Same!

actions.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
actions.lyrics: Make your arms a ga-tor mouth, / o-pen wide from north to south! / Chomp the big-ger, chomp, chomp, chomp, / now jump up and stomp, stomp, stomp!

karaoke.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C

slow.chords: C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G
slow.lyrics: Let's think it slow-ly! / Which is more, three or one? / Three! / Which is less, five or two? / Two!
